name: Golem Crafter (Artificer Archetype)
body:
A golem crafter works on perfecting golemcrafting and are protected by their own creation.

Golem Guardian (Ex)

At 1st level, a golem crafter gains the assistance of a golem protector. The exact form of the golem is up to the creator. See the guardian golem section below for its statistics. This ability replaces all bonus metamagic feats, metamagic spell trigger, and metamagic spell completion.

Golem Connection (Su)

At 5th level, a golem crafter can telepathically communicate with any construct within 60 feet. They automatically know if an object or creature within that radius is a construct. This ability replaces retain charge.

Guardian Golem

The guardian golem has one of the following base statistics, chosen when created:

Size Medium; Speed 30 ft.; HP 20 bonus hit points; AC +4 natural armor; Attack slam (1d8); Str 15, Dex 12, Con -, Int 4, Wis 13, Cha 6; Special Qualities darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision)
Size Small; Speed 20 ft.; HP 10 bonus hit points; AC +2 natural armor; Attack slam (1d6); Str 12, Dex 18, Con -, Int 4, Wis 13, Cha 6; Special Qualities darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, Weapon Finesse)

The construct is made of metal and wood, has a minor animalistic intelligence, and it can wear any equipment built for its form. The golem will defend the golem crafter from any creature attacking them, but otherwise will follow the commands given by their maker.

They also improve as the golem crafter increases in level as follows (table below):

Level	HD	BAB	Fort	Ref	Will	Skills	Feats	N.	AC	Str/Dex	Special
1st	2	+2	+0	+0	+0	2	1	+0	+0	Link, share spells
2nd	3	+3	+1	+1	+1	3	2	+0	+0	–
3rd	3	+3	+1	+1	+1	3	2	+2	+1	DR 5/adamantine
4th	4	+4	+1	+1	+1	4	2	+2	+1	Ability score increase
5th	5	+5	+1	+1	+1	5	3	+2	+1	–
6th	6	+6	+2	+2	+2	6	3	+4	+2	Devotion
7th	6	+6	+2	+2	+2	6	3	+4	+2	–
8th	7	+7	+2	+2	+2	7	4	+4	+2	–
9th	8	+8	+2	+2	+2	8	4	+6	+3	Ability score increase, multiattack
10th	9	+9	+3	+3	+3	9	5	+6	+3	–
11th	9	+9	+3	+3	+3	9	5	+6	+3	–
12th	10	+10	+3	+3	+3	10	5	+8	+4	–
13th	11	+11	+3	+3	+3	11	6	+8	+4	–
14th	12	+12	+4	+4	+4	12	6	+8	+4	Ability score increase
15th	12	+12	+4	+4	+4	12	6	+10	+5	DR 10/adamantine
16th	13	+13	+4	+4	+4	13	7	+10	+5	–
17th	14	+14	+4	+4	+4	14	7	+10	+5	–
18th	15	+15	+5	+5	+5	15	8	+12	+6	–
19th	15	+15	+5	+5	+5	15	8	+12	+6	–
20th	16	+16	+5	+5	+5	16	8	+12	+6	Ability score increase
Class Level

The character’s artificer level. The golem crafter’s class levels stack with levels of any other classes that are entitled to a guardian golem for the purpose of determining the companion’s statistics.

HD

This is the total number of ten-sided (d10) Hit Dice the guardian construct possesses. The construct has no Constitution. However, they gain a bonus to hit points based on their size.

BAB

This is the guardian construct’s base attack bonus. A guardian golem’s base attack bonus is the same as that of a fighter of a level equal to the construct’s HD. Guardian golems do not gain additional attacks using their natural weapons for a high base attack bonus.

Fort/Ref/Will

These are the guardian golem’s base saving throw bonuses. A guardian golem has no good saves.

Skills

This lists the guardian golem’s total skill ranks. Guardian golems can assign skill ranks to any skill listed below. If a guardian golem increases its Intelligence to 10 or higher, it gains bonus skill ranks as normal. A guardian golem cannot have more ranks in a skill than it has Hit Dice.

Guardian golems can have ranks in any of the following skills: Acrobatics (Dex), Climb (Str), Escape Artist (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Perception (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Stealth (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Feats

This is the total number of feats possessed by a guardian golem. Guardian golems can select any feat they are physically capable of using.

Natural Armor Bonus

The number noted here is an improvement to the guardian golem’s existing natural armor bonus.

Str/Dex Bonus

Add this value to the guardian golem’s Strength and Dexterity scores.

Link (Ex)

A golem crafter can give commands to their guardian golem companion as a free action.

Share Spells (Ex)

The golem crafter may cast a spell with a target of “You” on their guardian golem (as a touch range spell) instead of on themselves. A golem crafter may cast spells on their guardian golem even if the spells normally do not affect creatures of the companion’s type (construct). Spells cast in this way must come from a class that grants a guardian golem. This ability does not allow the guardian golem to share abilities that are not spells, even if they function like spells.

DR 5/adamantine (Ex)

The guardian golem gains DR 5/adamantine.

Devotion

A guardian golem gains a +4 morale bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.

Ability Score Increase (Ex)

The guardian golem adds +1 to any one of its ability scores.

Multiattack

A guardian golem gains Multiattack as a bonus feat. They gain a second slam attack, albeit at a –5 penalty.

DR 10/adamantine (Ex)

The guardian golem increases their DR to DR 10/adamantine.
